title: ActorReferenceV1
description: ActorReference version 1: the SCS pilot's definition, with no referenceVersion field (AAB-PLATFORM-03, 'The pilot definition'). Every record stored before version 2 keeps it, unchanged, and it stays readable. New records are written as version 2. A reader treats roles as grants with scopeType DEPLOYMENT, organizationId as unverified, and the issuer as the deployment's own.

actorId.description: Stable identifier of the person or service. Unique within the deployment.

actorType.description: Whether the actor is a person or an automated service.

roles.description: Roles held by the actor, e.g. COMPLIANCE_OFFICER, unscoped. Capabilities decide which roles they accept.

organizationId.description: Organisation the actor declared it acts for, if any. Unverified.

authenticationMethod.description: How the actor was authenticated for this request.
